identity.title: Move Learn Window document launch behind the existing composition boundary

origin.summary: The user requested that Partial refactoring continue in scheduled cycles and that remaining Tool/Learn Partial responsibilities be corrected structurally.

state.current_summary: OpenVisionLearnWindow의 code-behind가 concrete Learn 문서 서비스를 직접 호출하지 않고 명시적 Action<string> callback을 발행하도록 변경했다. Shell/Tool/Threshold composition controller가 기존 OpenVisionWorkspaceLearnDocumentService를 연결하며, XAML/animation/topic/threshold/public action 계약과 Window lifetime은 유지했다. Debug/Release source contract/build 및 단일 모니터 WPF smoke가 통과했고 외부 브라우저/전체 UI 행렬은 미검증으로 남겼다.

objective.summary: Remove the concrete Learn document service call from the required OpenVisionLearnWindow XAML Partial and route document actions through the existing Shell/Tool composition owners without changing visible controls, topic mapping, or Learn Window lifetime.
constraints: Work only in C:\Git\2D\Dev; do not modify C:\Git\2D\Original.
Reuse OpenVisionWorkspaceLearnDocumentService and existing Learn Window controllers; do not add a service, interface, manager, event bus, wrapper, or Partial.
Preserve OpenVisionLearnWindow XAML names, automation IDs, topic catalog mapping, threshold event, practice/tool callbacks, and controller cleanup.
Keep test outputs and evidence under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev.
Do not commit, push, tag, release, deploy, or mutate the Original repository.

criteria.text: The proof report records current and intended owners, caller path, mutable-state writer, lifetime owner, binding/public contract, shortest reading order, and matching test.

OpenVisionLearnWindow no longer references OpenVisionWorkspaceLearnDocumentService or OpenLearnDocumentFile; all known production constructors wire the existing service through SetOpenLearnDocumentAction.

Focused Debug/Release contracts and builds, relevant WPF Learn smoke, readiness, structural audit, documentation index, issue validation, and diff checks pass; external browser and full UI/native matrices are explicitly unverified.

milestones.summary: Inventory Learn Window callers, topic/document owner, mutable state, binding, and lifetime.
Replace the Window-to-service direct call with the explicit callback and wire all known production composition owners.
Run focused source/build/WPF smoke proof and record durable evidence.

artifacts.summary: Fresh Learn foundation WPF smoke screenshot on the detected single monitor.
Fresh Shell Learn-entry WPF smoke screenshot on the detected single monitor.

evidence.observation: The required Learn Window Partial now owns only the explicit document callback boundary; the three known production composition owners wire the existing document service. The Window's topic, XAML, threshold, practice/tool callback, and lifetime contracts remain.
LearnWindowDocumentBoundaryContract passed 6/6 in Debug and Release. WPF Learn foundation and Shell Learn entry smoke targets also passed.

VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke and OpenVisionLab.sln Debug/Release builds passed with 0 warnings/errors; PipelineViewerScreenshotSmoke x64 Debug passed with 0 errors and three pre-existing warnings; one-monitor WPF smoke produced fresh PNG evidence. Readiness, RefactorAudit, DocumentationIndex, issue-ledger, and diff checks are recorded in phase-summary.

events.summary: OpenVisionLearnWindow은 required XAML Partial이므로 제거하지 않는다. 다만 code-behind의 concrete document service 호출은 presentation adapter가 소유할 이유가 없으므로 Action<string> 결과 경계를 추가하고, 기존 Shell/Tool/Threshold composition controller에서 service owner를 연결한다.
PL-0034의 세 completion criteria와 세 milestone이 현재 증거로 충족되어 resolved로 닫는다. 외부 browser launch, 전체 topic/theme/DPI/input 행렬, hardware/native runtime은 이 slice의 검증 범위가 아니다.

The Window-to-service coupling was removed, explicit composition wiring was verified, and focused source/build/runtime evidence was recorded. Do not reopen this boundary without a new requirement, reproducible defect, failed criterion, or changed dependency boundary.
